description:
Add a screenshot or GIF to the article. Returns a screenshot_id to place in the article via update_article using `<SCREENSHOT screenshot_id>`.

- kind="image": one of `timestamp` (capture a frame from the project's base video), `mcp_upload_id` (an uploaded image: `mup_…` from upload_file, or a Clueso upload_id) or `source_url` (an image URL, e.g. one generate_media returned).
- kind="gif": pass `timestamp` (start) and `duration` (seconds). Captures a short GIF clip from the base video. Requires the project to have a video clip.

duration.description: kind='gif' only: GIF duration in seconds.

mcp_upload_id.description: kind='image' only: attach an uploaded image (mcp_upload_id from upload_file, or a Clueso upload_id) instead of capturing from video.

source_url.description: kind='image' only: an https image URL to download and attach.

timestamp.description: kind='image': capture frame at this timestamp (seconds). kind='gif': GIF start time.

name: add_article_media
title: Add article media (image or GIF)
